Summary
StreamlineMD, LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of PRC Medical, LLC. We are a technology-enabled
business service company serving the healthcare industry. Specifically, we offer cloud-based clinical
workflow and revenue cycle management technology and services tailored to meet the specific
workflow and business needs of imaging and image-guided procedure specialists, to improve their
practice and business performance and help them prosper.



170.315 (b)(10) Electronic Health Information Export
    •   StreamlineMD EHR Version 15.0 allows clients to export Clinical or Healthcare data for patient
        records without the intervention of software developers. The data may be exported as a C-CDA
        or PDF document. The Electronic Health Information (EHI) export may be done for a single,
        multiple, or entire patient population using C-CDA United States Core Data for Interoperability
        (USCDI v1) requirements. More information on USCDI v1 may be obtained from the below URL:
        https://www.healthit.gov/isa/united-states-core-data-interoperability-uscdi#uscdi-v1
    •   The use case for export may be for Single, Multiple, or All patient records.
    •   The Electronic Health Information may be exported in C-CDA, PDF, or both formats. The client
        shall select the folder in which the intended data needs to be exported.
